pwk.description: Depok City Government · BKPSDM & Diskominfo Municipal Systems.

pwk.title: Modul Perpindahan Wilayah Kerja (PWK)
pwk.summary: Full-stack web module for managing civil servant work-area transfers and rotations at Pemerintah Kota Depok, featuring multi-tier approval workflows, automated document generation, and rigorous functional testing.
contributions: Developed and implemented 13 functional features covering frontend interfaces, backend logic, and MySQL database operations using Laravel, PHP, and JavaScript.
Designed and built a relational MySQL database schema for tracking employee transfer history and work-unit placement data.
Contributed to requirements analysis, frontend interface implementation, and backend feature development for the PWK module.
Executed Black Box Testing across 46 test scenarios, achieving 100% pass rate to ensure application reliability.
Conducted System Usability Scale (SUS) evaluation resulting in a score of 95/100 (Grade A – Excellent) from 7 stakeholder respondents.
features: Multi-tier Role Based Access Control (Applicant, BKPSDM Verifier, Department Head)
Digital Document Submission Workflow with Change Audit Log
Automated PDF SK Transfer Letter Generator & Digital Verification
Real-time Work Area Distribution Summary Dashboard

skj.title: Modul Pengajuan Standar Kompetensi Jabatan (SKJ)
skj.summary: Full-stack web module for proposing, mapping, and standardizing technical and managerial competencies for government position classifications, built with Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript.
contributions: Developed and implemented 8 operational features across frontend interfaces, backend logic, and MySQL database integration over approximately 3 months.
Built a competency matrix validation module aligned with KemenPAN-RB standard guidelines, covering both frontend views and backend processing.
Implemented a review notification system and document version revision history using Laravel and MySQL.
Collaborated with team members to support requirements analysis and ensure application functionality aligned with user requirements.
Executed Black Box Testing to validate multi-tier approval flow integrity and access control per user session.
features: Dynamic Competency Matrix Form with Automated Weighted Score Calculation
Multi-step Document Review Workflow (Draft, Technical Review, Final Approval)
Official Document Export for Competency Standards

tasya-portfolio.title: Anatasya Interactive Portfolio
tasya-portfolio.summary: A modern full-stack portfolio website built with Laravel 12, Inertia.js, React, Tailwind CSS 4, and Motion — showcasing software engineering work with immersive UI/UX and interactive layered project showcases.
contributions: Designed a clean, minimal UI/UX system with light/dark mode and smooth micro-animations.
Built the signature interactive component: Layered Image Parallax Showcase with desktop pointer control and responsive mobile reflow.
Architected a decoupled frontend-first SPA structure integrated with Laravel backend, ready for MySQL & RESTful CRUD.
features: Editorial Hero Section with cursor parallax motion depth
Interactive Layered Image Showcase with case-study modal & detail view
Bilingual Language Switcher (Indonesian & English) with instant state toggle
Interactive contact channels with clipboard quick-copy and accessibility
